university.name: London South Bank University
university.summary: London South Bank University teaches at its Southwark campus in central London, as stated on its course pages. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate study in areas including business, computing and construction. Its international pages list entry routes for Pakistan and a set of international scholarships.

courses.title: Project Management
courses.duration_text: 12 months full-time; placement variants of 12, 15 or 24 months
courses.overview: A 180-credit taught Master's at the Southwark campus, accredited by the Association for Project Management. It is taught through lectures, seminars, workshops, case studies and simulations, and ends with a 60-credit capstone project.
courses.academic_requirements: At least a UK 2:2 undergraduate degree or equivalent in a business-related subject, or a UK 2:2 or equivalent with relevant professional experience. Applicants from all disciplines are welcome. Stated for 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with no less than 5.5 in any component. The page names no other tests beyond a recognised English language qualification.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant professional experience is an alternative for applicants whose degree is not business-related.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, postgraduate entry (any one of): three-year Bachelor's degree with 65% and above; four-year Bachelor's degree with 55% and above; two-year Bachelor's plus two-year Master's (1st class). A small number of postgraduate courses require work experience. The page gives no CGPA.
courses.career_notes: The page lists roles such as Project Manager, Programme Manager, Change Manager, Operations Manager and Consultant, with past employers including IBM and the NHS.
courses.application_deadline_note: The course page lists September, January and May starts without a year (May described as new for 2026). The international how to apply page says 2027 intake deadlines vary by region and shows all dates as TBC.
courses.notes: Fee shown is the 2026/27 international fee for standard full-time variants (GBP 18,900); variants with internship or placement are GBP 20,160. Fee is recorded as the total for the one-year course; target year fee not yet published. Fees can rise after year one.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time; 4 years with optional work placement year
courses.overview: A three-year computing degree at the Southwark campus with pathways in artificial intelligence, data engineering and cyber security, plus a broad-based option. An optional work placement year is available.
courses.academic_requirements: 112 UCAS points and GCSE Maths grade 4 (C) or equivalent; A-level grades are not specified. LSBU states every course requires five GCSE passes at grade C or above, including English and Maths, or Functional Skills Level 2. Stated for 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: From the LSBU undergraduate entry requirements page for international applicants: Academic IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5; PTE Academic 59 overall and in each skill; TOEFL iBT 80 overall (Reading 18, Listening 17, Writing 17, Speaking 20). Other tests are listed on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, undergraduate entry (any one of): three passes at GCE A Level with grades depending on the course; IB Diploma at 24 points or higher; accredited UK Foundation programme at 55 to 60% or higher; two-year Bachelor's from a recognised Pakistani institution at 60% or higher; HSC with 70% and above. The page gives no CGPA.
courses.career_notes: The page lists roles such as computer programmer, IT consultant, web developer and app designer, and mentions BCS accreditation in its careers section.
courses.application_deadline_note: The course page shows a September 2026 start next and entry requirements for 2027 entry; no 2027 start month is shown. The international how to apply page shows 2027 intake dates as TBC.
courses.notes: Fee shown is GBP 17,880 per year for 2026/27 (page total GBP 53,640 for three years); target year fee not yet published. The 70% HSC figure is one of several alternative routes on the Pakistan page. The course page itself gives no English scores; they come from the undergraduate entry requirements page. Module years are not labelled on the page.

courses.title: Construction Project Management
courses.duration_text: 12 months full-time (cognate MSc); part-time also offered
courses.overview: An accredited taught Master's for construction and development professionals, with a cognate route and a non-cognate route that adds supplementary modules. The MSc is accredited by the Chartered Institute of Building and the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors.
courses.academic_requirements: Cognate route, normally one of: a 2:2 or above in a relevant Built Environment discipline or Construction Management; corporate membership of a relevant professional body; an equivalent qualification; or a 2:2 or above in any subject plus some construction or development experience. Non-cognate route: a 2:2 or above in any discipline. Stated for 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: Overseas applicants need competency in spoken and written English. The page states written English as IELTS 6.5 or above and gives no overall score, band scores or spoken English score.
courses.experience_requirements: Construction or development experience is an alternative for applicants with a 2:2 in an unrelated subject (cognate route).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, postgraduate entry (any one of): three-year Bachelor's degree with 65% and above; four-year Bachelor's degree with 55% and above; two-year Bachelor's plus two-year Master's (1st class). The page gives no CGPA.
courses.career_notes: The page lists graduate roles with client organisations, professional practices, local authorities, housing associations and major contractors.
courses.application_deadline_note: The course page lists September and January starts without a year. The international how to apply page says 2027 intake dates are TBC.
courses.notes: Fee shown is the 2026/27 international fee for the cognate full-time MSc (GBP 18,360); the non-cognate full-time MSc is GBP 22,440. Target year fee not yet published. Overall IELTS and band scores are not stated on the page, so min_ielts fields are null.

scholarships.name: Global Success Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 4,000 in the first year, by school: Business, Computer Sciences, Nursing and Midwifery GBP 3,500 undergraduate and GBP 4,000 postgraduate; Allied Health, Engineering and Design, Construction and Property, Architecture and Planning, Law and Education GBP 2,500 and GBP 3,000; Arts and Social Sciences GBP 2,000
scholarships.summary: A first-year award for international students who accept an offer and pay an early deposit by a set deadline. The value depends on the school and on whether the course is undergraduate or postgraduate.
scholarships.criteria_text: Open to international students on acceptance of an offer and payment of an early deposit by the set deadline. First year of entry only.
scholarships.deadline_note: A set deposit deadline is referred to but no date is given.
scholarships.notes: The page does not mention 2027 entry, so whether current terms apply to 2027 entry is unconfirmed. Route is recorded as automatic because the page describes eligibility by accepting the offer and paying the deposit, with no separate form.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Merit Award
scholarships.summary: A merit award for international students with grades equivalent to AAB or above at UK A-level, or approximately 75% or above in other international school leaving certificates. It is available on acceptance of an offer and payment of an early deposit by a set deadline.
scholarships.criteria_text: Grades equivalent to AAB or above at UK A-level, or approximately 75% or above in other international school leaving certificates. Cannot be combined with another LSBU award (overview page).
scholarships.deadline_note: The deposit must be paid within four weeks of meeting all offer conditions (scholarships overview page); no calendar date is given.
scholarships.notes: The award page does not state a study level or entry year and was last modified on 5 February 2025; the undergraduate level comes from the scholarships overview page. Not confirmed for 2027 entry.

scholarships.name: Early settlement discount
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 off the year's course fee
scholarships.summary: A reduction for self-funded students who pay the year's fee in full by the full-payment dates. It applies only to the part paid directly to the university and not to sponsor-paid amounts or partial payment at enrolment.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded students paying in full by the stated full-payment dates. Not for sponsor-paid amounts or partial payment at enrolment.
scholarships.deadline_note: Full-payment dates on the page are for September 2026 and January 2027 starts; 2027 dates are not stated.
scholarships.notes: The page does not say how the discount is applied beyond paying in full, so the automatic route is inferred from the absence of an application step. Terms are for 2026/27.

scholarships.name: LSBU Pathway Progression Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 off headline gross tuition for the first year
scholarships.summary: For new self-funded international fee payers progressing immediately from a recognised pathway or partner or articulation institution. It cannot be combined with other scholarships.
scholarships.criteria_text: New self-funded international fee payers progressing immediately from an Ofqual-regulated Level 3 Foundation, an approved Level 4 International Year One, or a partner or articulation institution; academic and English entry requirements must be met. Excludes study abroad, short courses and research degrees.
scholarships.notes: Taken from the scholarships overview page only; no dedicated award page was opened. The route is recorded as nomination because eligibility depends on progression from a listed pathway provider; the page does not describe the application step. Entry year and deadline are not stated.
